strategy.offer: Handcrafted wooden decorative articles, especially seasonal pyramids, incense figures, arches, candleholders, music boxes, and accessories.
strategy.customers: Consumers seeking high-quality handcrafted seasonal home décor, gifts, and collectible wooden folk art.
strategy.why_we_win: The firm relies on longstanding craft tradition, detailed handwork, rich natural materials, and distinctive construction methods to create expressive premium pieces.
strategy.resources: Its basis is workshop craftsmanship in carving, turning, painting, assembly, material selection, and specialized in-house production techniques.

context.industry: Manufacture of wood and of products of wood and cork, except furniture; manufacture of articles of straw and plaiting materials

strategy.offer: Handcrafted wooden decorative and gift products, plus accessories, spare parts, repairs, themed collections, and custom small-batch items with optional lighting or music features.
strategy.customers: Private buyers and specialist retailers seeking high-quality seasonal and year-round wooden home décor, gifts, and collectible craft products.
strategy.why_we_win: They rely on careful handwork, strong design, customer-focused service, and emotionally appealing products that share their fascination with wood.
strategy.resources: Experienced loyal staff, in-house workshops, long-built design knowledge, fully self-made production, sustainably sourced wood, and capabilities for repair and customization.
strategy.direction: They are moving toward blending traditional woodcraft with contemporary designs and technology while investing in employees, service, sustainability, and broader customer access.
